info.description: GlobalMemory schemaVersion 2：版本化知識、結案案例、scope、證據、UNKNOWN 原因及回饋診斷。POC 沿用 /api/v1；既有外部消費者需同步升級。必填文字不得只有空白。所有 POST 須 Idempotency-Key。Job、交易、重試及結案規則沿用 backend/spec.md；AI_INPUT_TOO_LARGE 不可重試，不以 UNKNOWN 掩蓋技術失敗。

InitializeMemory.description: Initialization accepts only ORGANIZATION knowledge and INITIAL_INPUT evidence whose pointers resolve in this immutable payload. Missing optional arrays default to empty. Omitted knowledge/evidence are derived from legacy department descriptions; project experiences cannot be supplied.

AssignmentDecision.description: ASSIGNED requires MATCHED_RESPONSIBILITY, a unique existing department, only that candidate, empty missingInformation and positive responsibility evidence. UNKNOWN requires null departmentId, an UNKNOWN reason and actionable missingInformation. Multiple candidates require at least two department IDs; conflicting evidence cites both sides. All references belong to the fixed actual input.

FeedbackOutput.description: Maximum 400 candidates combined. PUBLISH needs evidence; ADD existingId is null; MERGE_EVIDENCE retains content and adds evidence only. Department identities stay fixed. Changed descriptions need ORGANIZATION support. The server allocates formal IDs and metadata.
